_readme: Faith Works events: the single source for every upcoming event on Home, Learn and Community. Add a record and it appears everywhere it belongs; no HTML changes. FIELDS: id + slug (stable ids) · title · shortTitle (optional, for tight spots) · type (workshop | masterclass | program | forum) + typeLabel (shown on the page) · status ('upcoming'; past moments go in event-highlights.json) · featured (true on ONE upcoming event: it leads Home and Community) · date: { day: '30', month: 'SEP', year: '2026' } drives the yellow date card and the sort order; null when not set yet · dateDisplay (optional human text for the schedule, e.g. a multi-session cohort) · dateLabel (shown when date is null, e.g. 'Dates to be announced') · location · audience · host · description · highlights (short bullets) · note (small print) · registrationUrl + registrationLabel: the ONE call to action (https:// links open in a new tab; undated events point to the notify form, community.html#register) · tags · image: every event has one ({ base + widths } for responsive files, or a plain path string with imageAlt). Until an event has its own photo, use one from a past Faith Works session and say so in image.caption.
